shared_elements: low relief carving of animals in profile
justification: Both are low reliefs that show animals and human-like figures in profile organised into horizontal registers, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a naturalistic narrative procession of clothed men leading a camel framed by rosette borders, while B shows schematic, disembodied predators, a bird of prey, snake-like elements and abstract arm/hand motifs with no procession or floral border; proportions and rendering conventions are quite unlike.
